title: Echo Chamber
description: A natural cavern of crystallized stone amplifies every sound into an infinite cascade of whispers. Footsteps from hours ago still reverberate off the walls, and the boundary between what is real and what is merely an echo grows impossibly thin.

choices.label: Capture the echoes
choices.description: Use a vial to trap the concentrated echo essence swirling in the chamber.

outcomes.text: You cork the vial at just the right moment. The trapped echoes swirl inside like liquid sound.
The echoes resist capture, but you manage to seal a concentrated dose. As a bonus, a prism shard tumbles from the wall.
The echoes surge as you open the vial, hitting you with a cacophony of amplified sound that leaves your ears ringing and vision swimming.

choices.label: Gather crystallized sound
choices.description: Some echoes have hardened into delicate prismatic formations on the walls.

outcomes.text: The crystallized echoes come away cleanly, chiming with stored resonance. They'll fetch a fine price.
You find a large formation of hardened sound-crystal, dense and heavy with trapped vibrations.
The crystal shatters with a deafening shriek that reverberates endlessly. Your vision blurs from the sensory assault.

choices.label: Leave the echoes behind
choices.description: The overlapping voices are disorienting. Best to move on before losing your way.

outcomes.text: You plug your ears and retrace your steps. The whispers follow you for a while, then fade to nothing.
